| Every response (2xx, 4xx, 5xx, and unknown routes) includes a non-empty `X-Request-Id` header. | ✓ verified | API-REQUESTID-01, API-REQUESTID-02, API-REQUESTID-03, API-REQUESTID-04, API-REQUESTID-05, API-REQUESTID-06, API-REQUESTID-07 |

| The `request_id` in the log line equals the `X-Request-Id` response header. | ✓ verified | E2E-REQLOG-02, E2E-REQLOG-03, E2E-REQLOG-07 |
| A 404 request is logged at `WARN`, and an induced 500 is logged at `ERROR`. | ✓ verified | E2E-REQLOG-04, E2E-REQLOG-05, E2E-REQLOG-09 |
| Request bodies (e.g., a task title sent in `POST /tasks`) never appear in log output. | ✓ verified | E2E-REQLOG-06 |
